findings.location: Translation paragraph referencing social media (paragraph starting “我们生活在一个“以我为中心”的时代”)
findings.source_quote: The conservative, Anabaptist people are getting tangled up in social media, selfies, tweeting, Facebook, and you name it.
findings.suggested_fix: Use more standard/idiomatic Mandarin for modern social terms. Replace 自照相 with 自拍, 推文 with 推特/发推 or 发布推文, and consider using 社交媒体（如自拍、推特、脸书等）for natural flow.
findings.translation_quote: 保守的门诺派（安那巴普蒂斯特）人正在被社交媒体、自照相、推文、脸书以及其它各种东西纠缠上。

findings.source_quote: The conservative, Anabaptist people ...; many Anabaptists are losing their children ...; the early Anabaptists met ...
findings.suggested_fix: Maintain a single, conventional Chinese rendering for “Anabaptist” for consistency. Either use “再洗礼派/再洗者派（Anabaptist）” or the more commonly used “安那巴普蒂斯特/再洗派”，or if the intended referent is Mennonites use “门诺派/门诺教会”。 Keep one term throughout.
findings.translation_quote: 保守的门诺派（安那巴普蒂斯特）人……许多安那巴普蒂斯特人把孩子输给黑暗国度的原因……早期的安那巴普蒂斯特人尽可能多地聚会……
